missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На юг' uses the accusative after 'на' to show motion toward the south. 'Летом' is the instrumental of time meaning in summer.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На юг' marks the destination of the migration with the accusative. 'Птицы' is the nominative plural subject and 'осенью' adds the season.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На юге' uses the prepositional form 'юге' after 'на' to show static location. 'Страны' is the genitive specifying which country's south.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'с'. 'С юга' uses the genitive form 'юга' to show origin of the wind. 'Ветер' is the nominative subject of 'дует'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На юге' is the prepositional form locating the warm weather. 'Погода' is the nominative subject, and 'всегда' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К югу' uses the dative form 'югу' to show direction toward the south. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject of 'ведёт'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'за'. 'За югом' uses the instrumental form 'югом' to mark position beyond the south. 'Город' is the nominative subject of 'расположен'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Юг' is the nominative subject described by 'богат'. The instrumental nouns 'фруктами и солнцем' name what the south is rich in.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Юг' is the accusative direct object of 'любим'; as an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative. 'Тёплый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.

Strategic focus: Accusative of orientation. 'На юг' uses the accusative to show the direction the windows face. 'Окна' is the nominative plural subject and 'солнечный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
